snippet.description:
A strong UPSC Prelims preparation begins with learning from the right teachers. In this video, get a glimpse of the experienced faculty team that will guide aspirants through the Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027 at LevelUp IAS.

From History and Geography to Polity, Economy, Science & Technology, Environment and Current Affairs, every subject is handled by experienced educators with a strong understanding of the UPSC examination.

Meet the PMP 2027 Faculty:

Nikhil Sheth Sir – Ancient, Medieval History and Art & Culture
Vivek Singh Sir – Indian Economy
Vishal Singh Sir – Modern Indian History
Gunasekaran Babu Sir – Indian Polity
Akhilesh Srivastava Sir – Geography
Himanshi Ahuja Ma’am – CSAT
Santosh Kumar Sir – Science & Technology, Environment and Current Affairs

PMP 2027 is designed to bring together experienced faculty, structured classroom learning, comprehensive PYQ coverage, GS Command Prelims Notes, regular practice tests, revision and mentorship to help aspirants prepare systematically for UPSC CSE Prelims 2027.
